description: Convert money using a reference rate. Returns {amount,currency}, rounded to the target's minor units (8 significant figures for metals/crypto). Set details for the rate and effective date too; identity conversions have rate 1 and date null.

amount.description: Numeric amount in the source currency; normalize localized input first.

date.description: Date YYYY-MM-DD for a past rate; omit for latest.

details.description: Include rate, effective date and provider if selected. Default false.

from.description: Source currency or asset code, e.g. USD, XAU or BTC.

provider.description: Institution's key, e.g. ECB or UST; omit for blended rates.

name: convert
title: Convert currency
